deck: Mango Street has taught photography on YouTube for ten years and across nearly 400 videos.  Its two founders have said it is ending, The Publish Press reported it yesterday, and the first reason they gave was that Squarespace is pulling out before the end of the year. tldr: Mango Street is closing after ten years, nearly 400 videos, a million subscribers and more than 60 million views, and the first reason its founders gave was that Squarespace is pulling out before year-end — with no revenue figures published, so nobody outside knows what share of the business it was.  Ask every creator partner this week what proportion of their channel revenue your deal represents, treat anything above roughly a third as a dependency rather than a placement, and stagger those renewals apart.

Arcade, the Sidemen's commercial business, presented its creator slate to more than 150 advertisers in London on 17 September and its Creator Access division holds a YouTube Partner Sales licence that enables guaranteed ad delivery against its roster.  Ask your creator partners and your agency in writing whether they can guarantee delivery, under what licence and with what make-good, and move any inventory where the answer is yes onto your paid video budget.

Somebody tagged 11,223 thumbnails from 1,043 channels over 100,000 subscribers, and the covers on each channel's best video differed from its ordinary ones by two percentage points on the only two features that moved at all, with the shocked face appearing on 11 percent of the covers that show a face rather than on most covers — and no click-through data was used, because it is private to each channel.  Cap thumbnail review at one round, put the time into the title and first ten seconds, and keep your own click-through figures on every cover you change.

Google's new Sidemen deal writes Gemini into the survival challenge as the thing the group has to use to solve it, across five videos split between one flagship episode on the main channel and four on the secondary channel five weeks later, and it is Google's second large creator deal in a month after MrBeast on 2 September.  Specify in your next creator brief whether the product is a removable block or a rule of the format, and lock your brand notes before the shoot if you choose the format version.

Rocket League peaked at 704,608 concurrent viewers, its first match above 700,000, on a semifinal rather than the final — and the release published no average concurrents, no duration and no channel count, while a second release the same day reported Free Fire growth counted across 290 broadcasting channels against 133 last edition.  Ask every seller for peak concurrents, average concurrents as an absolute, broadcast duration and channel count in writing before you respond to an offer, and price off peak alone when any are missing.

A creator marketing company published a 38 times more clicks per dollar result for Badia Spices, and the ads it beat were the brand's own static images and user-tagged content, with no absolute figures on either side and clicks standing in for purchases.  Run the comparison yourself with your best static advertisement against your best creator video, same budget and audience and offer, and report clicks per dollar and cost per purchase as absolute numbers on both sides rather than as a ratio.

Alex Cooper's Unwell added four YouTube shows fronted by other creators after a 500 million dollar pre-money valuation in August, and its Winter Games competition did 1.4 million views on the premiere and 1.8 million on its best episode, with a separate Summer Games edition carrying a 250,000 dollar prize pool.  Ask for per-episode views on the last three seasons before discussing price on any creator network original, and compare it against an individual creator of the same audience size.
